"""Sensor-driven KinDER controller. Uses only the documented Robot client."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
def observe(tag='obs'):
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
    res.save(OUT/tag)
    (OUT/'current.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta))
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    res=observe('initial')
    print(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    print(res.meta)
